brief.persona: I am booking a service visit for a home water softener.
brief.objective: Schedule a routine maintenance and diagnostic service visit for an existing residential water softener system.
facts: The whole-home water softener is leaking slightly around the bypass valve.
The home address is 412 Maple Ridge Lane.
preferences: Prefers an afternoon time slot if given a choice.
Wants confirmation of the total service fee prior to finalizing.

adjacent: You may also arrange service for the drinking-water filtration unit on the same visit if they raise it.

authorizedCommitments: Book one service visit on any weekday within the next three weeks.

spend.basis: for this visit including the call-out fee and any parts fitted

menuHints: The main menu offers service on 1, new installations on 2, billing on 3.

fields.name: agreedAmount
fields.description: Total amount agreed in USD, or empty if nothing was agreed

fields.name: appointmentStart
fields.description: Start of the booked arrival window, e.g. 2026-08-25T08:00

fields.name: appointmentEnd
fields.description: End of the booked arrival window, e.g. 2026-08-25T12:00

fields.name: secondUnitIncluded
fields.description: yes or no — whether the drinking-water unit is included in the visit

script.label: IVR menu greeting
script.text: Thank you for calling ClearPure Water Solutions. Press 1 for service on existing systems, press 2 for new installations, or press 3 for billing inquiries.

script.label: First agent greeting
script.text: Thanks for calling ClearPure service scheduling, my name is Mark. How can I help you today?

script.label: Ask for address
script.text: I can definitely help set up a service technician for that. Could I first get your home address?

script.label: Quote service fee
script.text: Thank you. Just so you know upfront, our diagnostic and service call fee is exactly 160 dollars, which covers the arrival and the initial inspection.

script.label: Transfer notification
script.text: Let me transfer you over to our regional dispatch coordinator, Elena, who can assign the specific technician for your area. Hold on one moment.

script.label: Second agent greeting
script.text: Hello, this is Elena in dispatch. Mark passed along your address and the issue with your water softener.

script.label: Offer arrival window
script.text: I have an opening available this Wednesday between 1:00 PM and 3:00 PM. Would that window work for you?

script.label: Request contact phone
script.text: What is the best phone number for the technician to call when they are twenty minutes away?

script.label: Confirm booking
script.text: All set! You are confirmed for Wednesday between 1:00 PM and 3:00 PM at 412 Maple Ridge Lane for the 160 dollars service call.

script.label: Closing
script.text: Thanks for choosing ClearPure Water Solutions, and have a great rest of your day!

script.label: Closing Confirmation
script.text: No, that's everything I need from you — you're all set. Thanks for calling, goodbye.
